plan.major: University Studies — Race, Gender, Ethnicity Concentration
plan.notes:
Per the 2026-2027 Texas A&M University undergraduate catalog: University Studies — Race, Gender, Ethnicity Concentration (BS). Prerequisites are not listed in the catalog's plan of study grid; consult course descriptions.
Catalog footnotes:
[grid1 fn1] One course on federal government and one course on state/local government will fulfill this requirement. Completing four semesters of upper-level ROTC may be substituted for 3 semester hours of the six hours required.
[grid1 fn2] Select from AFST 201 , GLST 201 , JWST 201/RELS 201 , LMAS 201 , WGST 200 , or any course approved by the Department of Global Languages and Cultures.
[grid1 fn3] Select from ANTH 404/WGST 404 , ANTH 427 ; COMM 335 , COMM 407/WGST 407 , COMM 420/WGST 420 ; PBSI 300/WGST 300 ; POLS 304 , POLS 317 , POLS 320 , POLS 367/WGST 367 , POLS 462/WGST 462 ; SOCI 207/WGST 207 , SOCI 317/AFST 317 , SOCI 323/AFST 323 , SOCI 403 , SOCI 410/WGST 410 , SOCI 421/WGST 421 .
